errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос представя системите... Вертикалната ос показва степента на приложение
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the axes. The vertical axis displays the categories (the systems), and the horizontal axis displays the values (степента на приложение) on a scale from 1.00 to 5.00.
The description incorrectly lists "Вид фирма" (Type of company) as one of the categories on the axis. "Вид фирма" is the title of the legend, not a category of information system.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са подредени по височина, от най-ниската към най-високата
errors.evidence: The description claims the bars are sorted by value, which is incorrect. The categories on the vertical axis are not arranged in ascending or descending order of their corresponding values. For instance, the category with the highest value (4.11) is fourth from the top.

errors.text_span: Търговска фирма е представена със сив цвят, а Преработвателна - с черен.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the colors to the company types. According to the legend, 'Търговска' (Commercial) is represented by black bars, and 'Преработвателна' (Manufacturing) is represented by gray bars. The description reverses this.

errors.text_span: Някои стълбове са обозначени с конкретни числови стойности
errors.evidence: The description states that 'some' bars are labeled with values. In fact, all bars in the chart have their specific numerical values displayed on them.
